jobs.title: Senior Director, Global Delivery Lead - Data Retention
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Director, Global Delivery Lead - Data Retention

Location: Waterloo, ON (Hybrid)

Duration: Contract

Rate: CAD$120-130/hr INC

The opportunity

We are seeking a senior global delivery leader to establish and lead the program office for the Global Data Retention Management Program. The program will coordinate enterprise efforts to identify, secure, classify and remediate over-retained structured and unstructured data, using a risk-based approach and a common global framework. The role is accountable for turning a complex cross-enterprise mandate into an executable roadmap, strong governance, transparent reporting and measurable outcomes.
This is a hands-on leadership role for a self-starter who creates clarity, builds momentum and takes ownership. The successful candidate will work across business groups and control functions, lead a team of project managers and workstream leads, and engage senior business and technology leaders to resolve issues and maintain alignment.

Key accountabilities

· Own integrated delivery across discovery, planning, execution and transition to sustainable business-as-usual controls. · Establish and run the program management office, including the integrated roadmap, and master schedule. Coordinate with regional delivery teams on their work breakdown structure, resource plan, financial controls and delivery standards. · Design and operate program governance, including steering committee, governance committee and working-team forums, with clear decision rights, escalation paths and accountabilities. · Lead multiple project managers, workstream leads, internal teams and external delivery partners. Set expectations, remove barriers and drive timely decisions. · Develop executive communication and reporting models covering progress, outcomes, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, financials and capacity. · Create and maintain stakeholder, governance, communications, change and adoption plans suited to a global, federated delivery model. · Partner with business groups to sequence work based on risk, readiness, dependencies and capacity while avoiding duplication with related initiatives. · Drive consistent execution across data inventory, risk tiering, security controls, classification, retention, disposition and sustainment workstreams. · Ensure delivery evidence, controls and reporting are clear, traceable and suitable for senior management, audit and regulatory review. · Manage vendors and systems integrators, including scope, deliverables, commercial performance, quality and knowledge transfer.

Measures of success

· A credible global roadmap, governance model and integrated delivery plan are established and actively used. · Senior leaders have clear, concise and timely visibility into outcomes, trade-offs, risks and decisions. · Workstreams have accountable owners, realistic plans and disciplined execution rhythms. · Priority data risks are addressed through a repeatable model that business groups can sustain.

Experience and expertise

Stakeholder leadership
· Operate confidently with Business Group CIOs and senior business leaders at VP and SVP levels. · Build alignment across Technology, Data, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, Risk, Privacy, Compliance, Legal, Records Management, Audit and business teams. · Frame complex issues simply, present clear options and secure timely decisions without overloading leaders with detail. · Influence across organizational boundaries, manage competing priorities and maintain constructive challenge when commitments are at risk. · Create trusted relationships while preserving clear accountability for outcomes, decisions and follow-through.
Leadership competencies
Ownership and drive Acts as the accountable leader, anticipates needs and follows issues through to resolution.
Self-directed execution Creates structure from ambiguity, mobilizes quickly and works effectively with limited direction.
Enterprise perspective Connects delivery choices to risk reduction, business outcomes and long-term sustainability.
Executive communication Communicates with precision, adapts to the audience and makes decisions easy to understand.
People leadership Sets high standards, develops team members and creates a culture of accountability and collaboration. (No direct people management)
Pragmatic judgment Balances pace, control, cost, capacity and quality to keep a complex program moving.

Why this role matters

The Global Data Retention Management Program addresses a material enterprise need: reducing cyber, privacy and regulatory risk while creating stronger and more sustainable control over data assets (structured and unstructured). This role will shape how the organization mobilizes, governs and executes a complex global transformation, while building a delivery model that can be sustained across business groups.

Critical Skills / Must-Haves:

10+ years of progressive experience leading large, complex enterprise programs, including global or multi-business transformation.
Demonstrated success building and running a large program office with multiple project managers, workstreams, delivery partners and senior sponsors.
Strong command of program governance, integrated planning, dependency management, RAID management, financial oversight, resource planning and executive reporting.
Experience delivering programs in data governance, data management, records and information management, cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory remediation, technology risk or related domains.
Ability to translate strategy and risk objectives into practical work packages, milestones, measures and accountable execution.
Experience leading federated programs where central standards and governance support execution by business or regional teams.
Working knowledge of structured and unstructured data environments, data lifecycle practices, classification, retention and disposition concepts.
Experience managing consulting firms, systems integrators and specialist vendors in outcome-based engagements.

Nice-to-Haves:

Financial services, insurance or another highly regulated industry.
Enterprise data governance, data lifecycle management, information management or data remediation.
Cyber risk reduction, privacy, audit, regulatory remediation or control transformation.
Operating-model design, organizational change and business adoption.
Agile and traditional delivery methods, with sound judgment on where each approach fits.

Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Program management certification is an asset.

Interview Process

• Likely 2 interview rounds (may be reduced to 1 if schedules permit). • Interview panel expected to include: o Hiring Manager o Hiring Manager's leader o Additional AVP stakeholder • Interviews are expected to be virtual.
Program & Compliance Requirements

• Is Reliability Clearance Required? No • Does the Role Require Privileged System Access via CyberArk? No o If No: Tier 1 background check required.
Notes for Agencies: Supplier Strategy Call Summary

Role: Senior Director, Global Delivery Lead - Data Retention

Role Overview

This is a highly strategic, enterprise-level program leadership role responsible for standing up and leading a brand-new Global Data Retention Management Program. The successful candidate will create structure from ambiguity, establish the program office, build the roadmap, and drive execution across a complex, globally distributed organization.
The program is in its infancy. There is no mature delivery framework in place, making this a true "build from the ground up" leadership opportunity. The leader will define the strategy, workstreams, governance model, roadmap, and execution approach.

Top Priorities (First 6-12 Months)

First 3 Months • Shape and define the overall Global Data Retention Program. • Build the program roadmap and execution plan. • Identify required workstreams and establish the PMO structure. • Develop governance, reporting, stakeholder engagement, and delivery plans.
Months 4+ • Drive execution and oversight of all workstreams. • Coordinate delivery across multiple business groups. • Influence stakeholders to complete required remediation activities. • Maintain executive visibility and program momentum.

What the Hiring Manager Really Wants

Proven Enterprise Program Leader

The hiring manager emphasized that the ideal candidate has repeatedly led large-scale, complex enterprise programs and successfully navigated ambiguity and organizational complexity.
Candidates should demonstrate: • Multiple examples of leading enterprise-wide programs. • Ownership of a portfolio or program of projects versus a single project. • A track record of turning difficult, complex situations into successful outcomes. • Experience building PMOs and governance models from scratch.
Exceptional Stakeholder Management

This is one of the most important success factors.
The individual will often be responsible for influencing business units and executives to take action, even when they do not directly report to them.
Strong candidates will have: • Executive presence. • Experience influencing AVPs, VPs, SVPs, and CIO-level leaders. • Strong relationship-building skills. • Ability to push for accountability while maintaining positive partnerships.
Data Governance / Data Retention Expertise

While the Hiring Manager stated she may consider a truly exceptional program leader without direct data retention experience, candidates with data governance and data retention backgrounds will have a significant advantage because they will gain credibility much faster.
Preferred experience includes: • Data Governance • Data Retention • Records & Information Management • Regulatory remediation • Data lifecycle management • Information security-related data programs

Critical Industry Experience

Strong Preference
Financial Services experience is viewed as a requirement rather than a nice-to-have.
The manager specifically indicated candidates need credibility in regulated environments and should understand: • Regulatory-driven transformation programs. • Enterprise risk remediation. • Governance and control programs.
Highly Desired
Candidates who have worked on: • OSFI-driven initiatives. • E-21 related programs. • E-23 related programs. • Regulatory compliance and remediation efforts within financial institutions.

Program Background

The program exists because the organization has identified significant amounts of data being retained longer than required across the enterprise.
The initiative is focused on: • Reducing regulatory risk. • Complying with emerging OSFI requirements. • Identifying and remediating over-retained data. • Creating sustainable data retention controls globally.

Program Scope

Internal Team • Approximately 7-10 people within the Data Governance organization.
Broader Enterprise Reach • Expected to influence and coordinate with up to 100 stakeholders across business groups globally.
Workstreams • Anticipated 2-3 major workstreams initially. • Number may evolve as program planning progresses.

Global Experience Expectations

The role is global because the program spans: • Canada • United States • Asia • Other international business units
Candidates should have experience working across: • Multiple geographies • Large distributed stakeholder groups • Global governance models
Flexibility for occasional early morning or evening meetings with Asia-based stakeholders is expected.

What Would Make a Candidate Stand Out?

Ideal Candidate Profile
A senior program leader who can demonstrate: · 10+ years leading large enterprise programs · Financial Services experience · Data Governance / Data Retention experience · Regulatory remediation experience · OSFI E-21 or E-23 exposure · Experience building PMOs and governance structures from scratch · Strong executive communication skills · Ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority · Global program de

jobs.title: Director, Product Management: AI
jobs.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Job Description

AI is changing how travelers discover and buy travel. Based in Montreal, you will lead the Solutions business unit's AI product portfolio, from strategy through to products that ship and create measurable value for our partners.

What You'll Be Doing

You will define and own the multi-year AI product strategy and roadmap for the Solutions business unit, spanning agentic commerce, discovery, offer optimization and partner operations. You will turn that strategy into funded priorities, make trade-offs with executives, partners and engineering, and own outcomes including partner revenue, adoption, model quality and cost to serve. You will build a team of people who prototype and ship, hiring, developing and retaining strong product talent while removing the blockers that slow delivery. AI will be part of your daily operating model: you will use modern tools to prototype, design evaluations, test experiences and move ideas into live partner tests, working closely with AI Product Operations.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: A clear, agreed AI product strategy and roadmap for Solutions, an honest assessment of the team and a hiring plan, and at least one working prototype in front of a partner.
Six months: The team is staffed with builders and operating for speed, with clear ownership and rhythms with AI Product Operations and engineering; multiple AI products have gone from idea to live partner test in weeks.
Twelve months: Measurable partner revenue attributable to AI and agentic channels, a maturing agent distribution footprint, and a team recognized as the center of AI product excellence at Plusgrade.

What You Bring

10 or more years in product, including several years leading and developing product managers or applied AI teams, ideally in a B2B or platform business.
Hands-on experience designing and shipping ML, LLM or agent-based products that customers pay for, with a practical understanding of model drift, evaluation, hallucination, latency and cost trade-offs.
A track record of accelerating teams, hiring and developing builders, and moving products from idea to prototype to live partner test.
Strong commercial instincts: you connect product decisions to revenue, margin and partner outcomes, and collaborate effectively with engineering, data science, design and partner-facing teams.
Clear, direct communication with executives, partners and technical teams. Experience in travel, loyalty, e-commerce, marketplaces or pricing is an asset but not mandatory.

Why Plusgrade

Travel is about the moments that make a journey feel personal. At Plusgrade, we build the technology that makes those moments possible, from upgrade offers and loyalty experiences to revenue tools used by 575+ airline, hospitality, cruise, rail, and financial services partners worldwide.

The work is global, complex, and rewarding. You will solve meaningful problems, take ownership from idea to outcome, and work alongside people who are smart, curious, and committed to doing great work.

We also give our teams access to AI tools and the encouragement to use them thoughtfully, to move faster, explore ideas, and build better ways of working.

We trust our teams to do their best work. That means autonomy, flexibility, and room to grow.

Come help us shape the future of travel.

What You'll Love About Us

🏦 RRSP Matching

🏥 Comprehensive Health Plans
📅 Flexible Paid Time Off
✈️ Travel Experience Perk
🧘 Annual Wellness Perk
🚆 Commuter Perk
🌅 Tenure-Based Work From Anywhere Program
🍼 Parental Leave Top Up
🌍 Adventure Pass
🎓 Learning Allowance

Our Process

We believe every candidate deserves a fair, transparent experience, so regardless of outcome, everyone gets feedback.

Our process: Recruiter call → Team interview → Hiring Manager interview → Final Interview.

Plusgrade is an equal-opportunity employer committed to accessible recruitment. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender identity or expression, race, ethnic origin, creed, place of origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by law. Accommodation is available upon request. We may use AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess applicants for this role. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Financial Services
jobs.description:
Role

The Executive Director, Financial Services will report to the Assistant Deputy Minister/Senior Financial Officer in Transportation and Economic Corridors and will provide strategic leadership and direction to support the Alberta Public Service “One Finance” approach. In this role, you will build strong relationships with ministry business partners, senior ministry representatives, other ministries, and other jurisdictions. You will work collaboratively with other Executive Directors within the finance community and lead a team of management and professional staff.

As the Executive Director, Financial Services, you will lead the day-to-day planning and implementation of all ministry- specific fiscal management activities including budgeting, planning, reporting, accounting, governance, compliance, and internal controls. You will work proactively with the division leaders and program areas to provide strong financial advice and solutions based on technical knowledge, sound data, and effective analysis to support the government’s financial strategy and ministry mandate. Your implementation and innovative processes will enable you to deliver a suite of financial services within Transportation and Economic Corridors.

Qualifications

Your background will include significant related senior financial management experience in planning, reporting and control functions in a large, complex organization. Your solid financial acumen will enable you to leverage effective financial analysis. You have significant experience managing complex budget issues and providing advice to executive leadership. You have demonstrated capacity to influence critical decisions. You have distinguished yourself as a strategic leader with a reputation for empowering, mentoring, and developing capacity within your teams. Your proven leadership to inspire teams to achieve success is essential. Exceptional collaboration skills and a systems approach are essential for delivering results on ministry priorities. Communication and change management skills as well as the ability to develop and maintain effective stakeholder relationships will be key in balancing varying perspectives in a highly complex and changing business environment.

Post-secondary education in a related field is required. A recognized accounting designation is an asset.

Salary

$5,896.65 - $7,749.28 bi-weekly ($153,902.57 - $202,256.21 annually)

jobs.title: Director, Digital Experience Platforms
jobs.description:
Embark on a rewarding career with Sobeys Inc., celebrated among Canada’s Top 100 employers where your unique contributions drive success.

Role Summary

The Director, Digital Experience Platforms (DXP) is accountable for the strategy, engineering delivery, operations, reliability, and evolution of all customer-facing digital experience platforms across Empire banners. This role leads the technology execution of web, mobile, content, search, UX platform capabilities, and front-end engineering ecosystems, ensuring seamless, scalable, secure, and high-performing customer experiences.

The Director serves as the primary technology counterpart to Digital Experience, Digital Product, Customer Engagement, Commerce, and Banner teams, translating business vision into enterprise-grade digital capabilities. The role is responsible for balancing innovation, delivery velocity, operational excellence, and platform sustainability while enabling a product-led operating model.

Accountabilities & Responsibilities

Digital Experience Platform Leadership

Own the end-to-end technology strategy, roadmap, delivery, and operation of all digital experience platforms across web, mobile, and customer-facing digital channels.
Define the future-state architecture and capability evolution roadmap for DXP technologies including Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), front-end platforms, mobile applications, search technologies, design systems, and supporting digital services.
Ensure platform capabilities support enterprise digital commerce objectives, customer experience strategies, and banner-specific priorities.
Establish technology standards, engineering practices, and governance frameworks for front-end and customer experience platforms.

Engineering Delivery & Execution

Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for:
Customer websites
Mobile applications
Front-end engineering
Search and discovery platforms
Design systems
Content delivery platforms
AEM ecosystem

Drive delivery of strategic initiatives through Agile product teams.
Ensure predictable execution, release readiness, and high-quality software delivery.
Partner with Product and Business teams to define roadmaps, priorities, and release strategies.
Govern delivery performance, release quality, technical debt management, and modernization initiatives.

Digital Experience Reliability & Operations

Own availability, performance, scalability, and resilience of all digital experience platforms.
Establish operational excellence standards for:
Incident management
Production support
Monitoring and observability
Disaster recovery
Capacity planning

Lead major incident response and continuous service improvement initiatives.
Ensure regulatory, privacy, accessibility, and security compliance requirements are embedded within platform delivery.

UX Technology & Experience Enablement

Own the technology ecosystem that enables experience delivery, including:
Design systems
Component libraries
Content management capabilities
Front-end frameworks

Partner with UX and CX teams to ensure customer experience strategies are translated into scalable technology solutions.
Build strong alignment between design intent and engineering execution.
Enable consistency across banners while balancing local business needs.

Platform Modernization & Innovation

Champion modern engineering practices including:
Headless architecture
API-first development
Component-driven development
DevOps and CI/CD
Cloud-native architecture

Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve customer experiences.
Drive platform simplification and technology rationalization to reduce complexity and improve speed-to-market.

Leadership Responsibilities

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of managers, architects, Analysts and Developers.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, customer obsession, and operational excellence.
Build succession plans and talent development strategies for key digital capabilities.
Establish clear ownership and measurable outcomes across engineering and platform teams.
Create an environment focused on collaboration, continuous improvement, and execution excellence.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
Master's degree considered an asset.

Experience

12+ years of progressive experience leading large-scale digital engineering organizations.
Proven experience managing customer-facing digital platforms at enterprise scale.
Experience leading large Agile product and engineering teams.
Strong background in digital commerce, customer experience, or omnichannel retail environments.

Technical Expertise

Headless and composable architectures
React / Next.js ecosystems
Mobile application platforms (iOS and Android)
API and microservices architecture
Search and discovery technologies
Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
DevOps and CI/CD practices
UX design systems and front-end architectures

jobs.title: Director, Insights, Innovation and RandD (18-month contract)
jobs.description:
The Director, Insights, Innovation, & R&D leads the consumer insight, menu innovation, product development, and food quality agenda for KFC Canada. This role turns consumer and business insight into a growth-driving innovation pipeline, modernizes KFC's core products, and leads the FIT (Food Innovation & Technology aka Product Development) team from concept through commercialization. The Director partners closely with Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain and franchisees to ensure products are distinctive, consumer-led, operationally executable and delivered to KFC quality and food safety standards. If you are a leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can navigate ambiguity with action, has ambition to deliver impact and a spirit of what is possible – KFC is an environment that will empower and support your success.

Own the integrated consumer insights, menu strategy and innovation agenda, translating consumer, category and cultural insight into clear growth opportunities and the short-, medium- and long-term pipeline and business.
Lead the FIT team and end-to-end product development process, from culinary/product brief and prototyping through consumer validation, restaurant testing, commercialization and launch.
Modernize and continuously improve KFC Canada's core food portfolio, protecting what consumers love while improving taste, quality, consistency, value and relevance.
Build and deliver a differentiated innovation pipeline that supports the Marketing growth calendar, creates newsworthy reasons to choose KFC and strengthens the brand across priority occasions and consumer groups.
Act as guardian of KFC Canada's food philosophy and architect of the menu vision, defining the principles, product standards and strategic choices that guide product development and renovation.
Lead consumer insights across internal resources and agency partners, ensuring customer understanding is embedded in brand strategy, calendar development, innovation, value and broader business planning.
Set clear innovation learning agendas and stage gates; use consumer, operational and commercial evidence to make fast decisions on what to advance, optimize or stop.
Partner with Brand, Retail Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and franchisees to ensure innovation is commercially compelling, operationally executable, scalable and supported by strong launch plans.
Own R&D prioritization, resources and ways of working, ensuring the team balances core product improvement, calendar innovation, longer-term pipeline development and rapid test-and-learn opportunities.
Provide leadership oversight of Quality Assurance within the team remit, ensuring robust product and supplier standards, food safety and quality systems, issue escalation, and continuous improvement in partnership with Operations and Supply Chain.
Deliver credible thought leadership and compelling recommendations to KFC Canada LT, franchisees and cross-functional stakeholders, aligning the system behind bold but evidence-based growth choices.
Build a high-performing, connected Insights, Innovation, R&D and QA capability with clear accountability, strong talent development and effective collaboration across the broader business.

Education/Certifications

Required: Post-secondary degree in business, marketing, or related discipline
Preferred: MBA

Experience

10+ years of progressive experience across consumer insights, innovation, product development/R&D, brand, food science or related commercial functions
Demonstrated experience leading teams and an end-to-end food innovation pipeline from insight and concept through product development, testing, commercialization and launch
Style that inspires and unites cross-functional teams, bringing clarity in strategy and empowering whilst holding accountable with a spirit of taking people with you.
Compelling communications capability, translating complex ideas simply to bring clarity and alignment across a diverse set of stakeholders.
Strong track record of translating consumer insight into commercial growth strategies and high-impact innovation.
Strong understanding of operations, supply chain and commercialization requirements; able to balance consumer desirability, operational feasibility and commercial viability.
Proven ability to modernize core products while building a forward-looking innovation pipeline.
Ability to influence senior leaders, franchisees, and complex matrixed stakeholders through ambiguity and transformation.
Ability to effectively develop and lead high-performing technical and commercial talent.
Ability to balance enterprise-level strategic thinking with curiosity, creativity, pace, and hands-on problem solving.
A passion for food, consumers, and emerging trends

We’d prefer this role to have…

Prior experience in QSR, food manufacturing/FMCG, or food retail

What makes KFC a great place to work?

Our People.
We invest in people capability above all else, with a proven track record of developing internal talent to leadership levels across the business both in Canada and globally. We hire and develop people who lead with Smart, Heart and Courage to make a big impact on the business today and grow into leaders of the future.

Our Culture.
We are known for a culture that rewards and recognizes bold results and promises everyone a seat at our table. We focus on your personal development as much as your professional development to ensure you can bring your best self to work.

Why you’ll love working here

Hybrid work model (2-3 days per week in office)
Paid vacation and personal days, plus 10 paid KFC Canada holidays in addition to statutory holidays.
Comprehensive health and dental benefits, including HSA and PSA options that allow you to personalize your coverage, plus life insurance and disability coverage, with employer-paid premiums
Family-inclusive Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and virtual care
Paid parental leave with salary top-up
RRSP and DPSP retirement programs with employer matching
Annual tuition reimbursement program
Employee referral rewards
And so much more!

Note: remuneration, benefits, and other perks may vary by role, employment status, eligibility, and other relevant factors.

Chief Financial Officer

Providing peace of mind by helping members feel secure today and confident about tomorrow.

Full-time | Regina, Saskatchewan

Plannera is seeking a Chief Financial Officer who brings sound financial judgment, a thoughtful approach to leadership and an appreciation for the responsibility that comes with serving others.

This is an opportunity to help shape the organization’s future while sustaining the financial discipline and accountability on which trust depends. As a member of the executive team, the CFO will bring a clear financial perspective to strategic decisions, help colleagues assess opportunities and trade-offs, and ensure that financial advice is practical, well supported and understood.

The mandate calls for a leader who can move comfortably between strategy and execution. You will guide financial planning, reporting and stewardship, strengthen the information that informs decisions, and build a capable team whose contribution is valued across the organization. Your influence will come through the quality of your judgment, the relationships you develop and your ability to make complex matters clear.

You bring a recognized professional accounting designation (CPA) and substantial, progressive experience in senior financial leadership, including responsibility for financial strategy, planning, reporting, internal controls and audit. You have led teams in a complex organization and demonstrated the ability to translate financial analysis into clear advice for executives and governing bodies.

Your experience includes overseeing budgets and financial forecasts, strengthening controls and reporting practices, and working effectively with external auditors and other professional advisers. You understand how sound governance and risk management support organizational performance, and you exercise careful judgment when balancing operational needs with longer-term commitments.

Experience in pension administration, financial services or another regulated environment would be an asset, as would experience supporting boards or committees and leading improvements to financial systems and processes.

Alongside your technical qualifications, you bring the maturity and interpersonal skill expected of an executive leader. You communicate complex issues clearly, build productive relationships across functions and develop capable teams. You are comfortable offering an independent perspective, addressing difficult issues constructively and taking accountability for decisions.

For a leader who finds meaning in responsible stewardship and lasting institutional strength, this role offers the opportunity to make a substantial contribution to Plannera and the people it serves.

For more information or to receive a detailed position profile, please contact Leadership Source at 306-543-1666 or search@leadershipsource.ca.

jobs.description:
Type of position:
Regular

An Overview Of Your Future Role At BBA

BBA supports all players across the energy ecosystem, including power generation, transmission and distribution. We also support large industrial energy users, mainly in the mining, oil and gas sectors. More recently, we’ve seen growing demand from a new category of large energy consumers, particularly data centres. To date, BBA’s involvement in the data centre market has been largely reactive, with developers and builders reaching out to us for our expertise in grid interconnections and power systems. Going forward, BBA will take a deliberate and proactive approach to this market by establishing a dedicated data centre business line.

Drawing On More Than 45 Years Of Experience Solving Complex Electrical Challenges, BBA’s Go-to-market Strategy Will Be Guided By The Following Principles

Avoid commodity building design and leverage strategic partnerships where appropriate.
Focus on projects larger than 25 MW.
Lead the high-voltage scope.
Lead grid integration activities.
Lead substation design and delivery.
Lead generation strategy development.

An Overview Of Your Mandates And Responsibilities

You’ll source and ensure successful delivery of power projects to meet the energy needs of large-load clients, primarily data centres. You’ll also occasionally support other industrial, community and utility clients operating in remote or partially grid‑connected environments. Initially, the role will focus on regional clients across Canada and gradually expand to include the U.S. market.

As a renewable power professional, you’ll lead the modelling, optimization and delivery of complex energy projects involving renewable technologies, including wind, solar PV, BESS, thermal and hydroelectric power. Your work will include studies, roadmaps and project execution.

BBA operates within a matrix structure, and the New Large Loads business line you’ll lead has both national and international focus. The business line is accountable for defining market strategy and overseeing sector performance. To deliver on its mandates, it works closely with BBA’s operational teams and disciplines across Canada and the USA. While most projects are executed through these regional teams, the business line may also directly manage and deliver certain strategic initiatives.

Business development

Coordinate the development and execution of BBA’s data centre market strategy
Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders across the data centre, utilities and industrial sectors
Support the development of short‑, medium‑ and long‑term opportunity pipelines while identifying cross‑selling opportunities for BBA’s services
Support project sourcing efforts by identifying opportunities that align with regional priorities across Canada and evolving data centre power needs
Contribute to proposal development, client positioning and pursuit strategies for power and energy mandates
Maintain a strong understanding of energy market trends, particularly for data centres, off‑grid, hybrid and utility‑linked power systems.

Operations

Serve as project manager and technical lead for selected strategic projects, including project development support, feasibility studies, roadmaps and execution mandates
Provide subject‑matter expertise in the modelling, optimization and integration of renewable and hybrid power systems (wind, solar PV, CSP, BESS, thermal storage, hydroelectric)
Oversee technical reviews and coordinate engineering and design activities across disciplines
Work closely with BBA’s multidisciplinary teams across Canada to ensure execution excellence and alignment with client objectives
Help develop internal expertise in data centre development, power system optimization, hybrid energy solutions and renewable integration
Support the development of tools, methodologies and reference models for studies, roadmaps and system optimization
Participate in knowledge sharing and thought leadership activities, including internal training, technical contributions and industry engagements.

Do your qualities and values match our corporate culture?

Business acumen
Strategic vision
Action and results-driven
Ability to see beyond established standards
Constantly seeking sustainable and agile solutions
Rigour and ethical
Accountability and entrepreneurship
Client-oriented with existing network
Organizational agility.

Summary Of Certifications And Job Requirements

Engineering degree in a related discipline from a recognized university
At least 15 years of relevant experience
Experience in data centre development and execution, wind and/or solar power energy, consulting engineering, business development and project execution
Registered as a Professional Engineer in Canada
Experience in equipment selection, capital cost and operating cost estimates
Available to travel to domestic or international destinations is required.

About BBA

BBA is one of Canada’s leading private consulting engineering firms, with over 45 years of experience serving the energy and natural resources industry.

Our people are the foundation of our success. Their passion and excellence have earned us recognition as one of Canada’s Best Employers and Best Managed Companies , and we’re committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels empowered to grow, lead and be themselves.

Our teams bring together engineering, environmental and commissioning expertise to deliver practical, innovative and sustainable solutions—from strategy to execution. With 20 offices across Canada, the U.S. and Latin America, we combine local presence with international reach, offering clients close collaboration and field-ready support.

Learn more about our culture and projects on LinkedIn or connect with our talent team.

Job Description

AI is changing how travelers discover and buy travel. Based in Montreal, you will lead the Solutions business unit's AI product portfolio, from strategy through to products that ship and create measurable value for our partners.

What You'll Be Doing

You will define and own the multi-year AI product strategy and roadmap for the Solutions business unit, spanning agentic commerce, discovery, offer optimization and partner operations. You will turn that strategy into funded priorities, make trade-offs with executives, partners and engineering, and own outcomes including partner revenue, adoption, model quality and cost to serve. You will build a team of people who prototype and ship, hiring, developing and retaining strong product talent while removing the blockers that slow delivery. AI will be part of your daily operating model: you will use modern tools to prototype, design evaluations, test experiences and move ideas into live partner tests, working closely with AI Product Operations.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: A clear, agreed AI product strategy and roadmap for Solutions, an honest assessment of the team and a hiring plan, and at least one working prototype in front of a partner.
Six months: The team is staffed with builders and operating for speed, with clear ownership and rhythms with AI Product Operations and engineering; multiple AI products have gone from idea to live partner test in weeks.
Twelve months: Measurable partner revenue attributable to AI and agentic channels, a maturing agent distribution footprint, and a team recognized as the center of AI product excellence at Plusgrade.

What You Bring

10 or more years in product, including several years leading and developing product managers or applied AI teams, ideally in a B2B or platform business.
Hands-on experience designing and shipping ML, LLM or agent-based products that customers pay for, with a practical understanding of model drift, evaluation, hallucination, latency and cost trade-offs.
A track record of accelerating teams, hiring and developing builders, and moving products from idea to prototype to live partner test.
Strong commercial instincts: you connect product decisions to revenue, margin and partner outcomes, and collaborate effectively with engineering, data science, design and partner-facing teams.
Clear, direct communication with executives, partners and technical teams. Experience in travel, loyalty, e-commerce, marketplaces or pricing is an asset but not mandatory.

Why Plusgrade

Travel is about the moments that make a journey feel personal. At Plusgrade, we build the technology that makes those moments possible, from upgrade offers and loyalty experiences to revenue tools used by 575+ airline, hospitality, cruise, rail, and financial services partners worldwide.

The work is global, complex, and rewarding. You will solve meaningful problems, take ownership from idea to outcome, and work alongside people who are smart, curious, and committed to doing great work.

We also give our teams access to AI tools and the encouragement to use them thoughtfully, to move faster, explore ideas, and build better ways of working.

We trust our teams to do their best work. That means autonomy, flexibility, and room to grow.

Come help us shape the future of travel.

Embark on a rewarding career with Sobeys Inc., celebrated among Canada’s Top 100 employers where your unique contributions drive success.

Role Summary

The Director, Digital Experience Platforms (DXP) is accountable for the strategy, engineering delivery, operations, reliability, and evolution of all customer-facing digital experience platforms across Empire banners. This role leads the technology execution of web, mobile, content, search, UX platform capabilities, and front-end engineering ecosystems, ensuring seamless, scalable, secure, and high-performing customer experiences.

The Director serves as the primary technology counterpart to Digital Experience, Digital Product, Customer Engagement, Commerce, and Banner teams, translating business vision into enterprise-grade digital capabilities. The role is responsible for balancing innovation, delivery velocity, operational excellence, and platform sustainability while enabling a product-led operating model.

Accountabilities & Responsibilities

Digital Experience Platform Leadership

Own the end-to-end technology strategy, roadmap, delivery, and operation of all digital experience platforms across web, mobile, and customer-facing digital channels.
Define the future-state architecture and capability evolution roadmap for DXP technologies including Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), front-end platforms, mobile applications, search technologies, design systems, and supporting digital services.
Ensure platform capabilities support enterprise digital commerce objectives, customer experience strategies, and banner-specific priorities.
Establish technology standards, engineering practices, and governance frameworks for front-end and customer experience platforms.

Engineering Delivery & Execution

Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for:
Customer websites
Mobile applications
Front-end engineering
Search and discovery platforms
Design systems
Content delivery platforms
AEM ecosystem

Drive delivery of strategic initiatives through Agile product teams.
Ensure predictable execution, release readiness, and high-quality software delivery.
Partner with Product and Business teams to define roadmaps, priorities, and release strategies.
Govern delivery performance, release quality, technical debt management, and modernization initiatives.

Digital Experience Reliability & Operations

Own availability, performance, scalability, and resilience of all digital experience platforms.
Establish operational excellence standards for:
Incident management
Production support
Monitoring and observability
Disaster recovery
Capacity planning

Lead major incident response and continuous service improvement initiatives.
Ensure regulatory, privacy, accessibility, and security compliance requirements are embedded within platform delivery.

Design systems
Component libraries
Content management capabilities
Front-end frameworks

Partner with UX and CX teams to ensure customer experience strategies are translated into scalable technology solutions.
Build strong alignment between design intent and engineering execution.
Enable consistency across banners while balancing local business needs.

Headless architecture
API-first development
Component-driven development
DevOps and CI/CD
Cloud-native architecture

Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve customer experiences.
Drive platform simplification and technology rationalization to reduce complexity and improve speed-to-market.

Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of managers, architects, Analysts and Developers.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, customer obsession, and operational excellence.
Build succession plans and talent development strategies for key digital capabilities.
Establish clear ownership and measurable outcomes across engineering and platform teams.
Create an environment focused on collaboration, continuous improvement, and execution excellence.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
Master's degree considered an asset.

Experience

12+ years of progressive experience leading large-scale digital engineering organizations.
Proven experience managing customer-facing digital platforms at enterprise scale.
Experience leading large Agile product and engineering teams.
Strong background in digital commerce, customer experience, or omnichannel retail environments.

React / Next.js ecosystems
Mobile application platforms (iOS and Android)
